policy: Faithful editorial condensation for the film; source exports are unchanged. Failed attempts and troubleshooting are omitted, never relabeled successful.

part_b096495b5943.text: Compare twelve cantilever designs by varying the material budget and filter radius. Keep the geometry, loading and other constraints fixed. Run the study on Slurm, then make the results interactive.

part_f9d0d58fb3cf.text: I'll read the attached problem definition and check the inputs before submitting any cluster work.

part_1f2bc6198a38.text:
Four material budgets: 10%, 15%, 20% and 25%. Three filter radii: 0.10, 0.15 and 0.20.

That gives twelve cases, with the remaining problem settings held fixed.

part_145b25c63da9.text: Each case will start at its own volume fraction. The input decks have been built and checked with that choice.

part_8d4f5fbfbefc.text: The Slurm array is submitted. The first case is running; the others are waiting for resources. I'll monitor the array in the background.

live_call_bb2c24f185ff_call.title: Start the array watcher in the background

part_5cb3415927cb.text: Nine cases are now running. The last three are queued. I'll collect each case's output when its task finishes.

live_call_466eba64f0b6_call.title: Collect completed cases and check the final running task

part_09b57bf5dd10.text: All twelve jobs have completed, taking 10–19 minutes each. Every solver exited successfully, and the copied results match their checksums.

part_bc50350e3e32.text: Every case passes the acceptance checks. No optimization job needed resubmission. I'll now review the measured results.

part_a2481d8b0a71.text: The convergence and grayness measurements are ready. I'll register the results and final designs.

part_69ee82df6c81.text: Each design reached 50 iterations. The summary links every case to its parameters, final compliance, volume fraction and saved geometry.

part_7cf54da9dfb6.text: I'll make the case table drive the three-dimensional view and the matching file list.

part_9bf7633cb257.text: The dashboard will use the case, convergence and file tables.

part_96e693507d0f.text: Selecting a case will update its design, highlight its chart data and filter its files together.

part_fb6ffff07447.text: The interactive dashboard is ready to publish.

part_cc9122f681de.text: Published. The twelve designs are ready to explore.

part_5fe40ff0460b.text: Compare the original design with its smoothed version. Keep the same case and material budget.

part_853c1587cb43.text: I'll use the saved designs and branch records to bring the related results together.

part_67badd2b0e96.text: I'll check the geometry and result metadata before assembling the side-by-side comparison.

part_cf4d702cf9d4.text: Build an interactive topology-optimization studio for a cantilever. Let me inspect the mesh, choose solver-specific settings and explore results from Morphorm and Abaqus/Tosca.

part_f40e3c2d00df.text: The mesh job is queued. While it runs, I'll delegate the Abaqus/Tosca script to a specialist and prepare the studio.

part_dfe00fe9d971.text: Both meshes pass their checks. The structured HEX8 mesh has 13,824 elements and 15,925 nodes, with no inverted elements.

part_be73fdd4b04d.text: The ten-iteration Morphorm trial is submitted on Slurm. While it runs, I'll register the mesh geometry and build the dashboard.

part_e5651192f29d.text: The Morphorm trial has completed all ten iterations. Its objective fell from 2.65 million to 174,713, with mean density 0.150.

part_a068d5753d66.text: The Morphorm trial is saved, with its settings in the saved-trial record.

part_21197e8f8c95.text: The Abaqus/Tosca trial has also completed: ten cycles in 81 seconds. Its result database and geometry exports are ready.

part_2adadb278bf5.text: The final volume fraction is 0.147 against a limit of 0.15. I'll retain the solver fields and convergence data for inspection.

part_48204fa6648c.text: I'll register the Tosca result and trial-history table before removing its temporary run folder.

live_call_7708244c5598_call.title: Retain the Tosca fields and trial history

part_7ee3a3cefa90.text: The result artifacts are retained. I'll now discard the temporary Tosca run.

part_23efecd43923.text: The temporary folder is removed. Its recorded result remains available.

part_03b790bdefb4.text: The topology studio is ready to publish.

part_006c5f37d929.text: Published. The meshes, settings and recorded results are ready to inspect.
